latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Antekirt Illustration Skill.
- Generate illustrations, SVG vectors, and short videos in the style of real Antekirt artists.
- Supports listing artists, generating images with custom prompts, vectorizing, and animation.
- Requires ANTEKIRT_API_KEY and ANTEKIRT_BASE_URL environment variables.
- Includes both Node.js and curl-based usage options.
- Outputs direct URLs for generated images, SVGs, or videos.
